spooky-monster-tree-3d-print-model.d: A gnarled little tree crawling with monster faces that sets an uneasy, fun Halloween mood. Print it in near-black with a single glowing accent for maximum creep.

deaths-skull.d: A detailed skull with baroque flourishes that reads as art before it reads as spooky. It anchors a gothic shelf or a more refined Halloween display.
